dateFrom.title: From date
dateFrom.description: Start of the calendar range, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

dateTo.title: To date
dateTo.description: End of the calendar range, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 7 days after the start. Range is capped at 31 days.

tickers.title: Ticker watchlist (optional)
tickers.description: Only return events for these stock symbols. Leave empty to return the whole market calendar.

includeEarnings.title: Include earnings
includeEarnings.description: Companies reporting earnings, with EPS estimates and report time.

includeDividends.title: Include dividends
includeDividends.description: Upcoming ex-dividend, record and payment dates.

includeIPOs.title: Include IPOs
includeIPOs.description: Priced and upcoming initial public offerings.

includeSplits.title: Include stock splits
includeSplits.description: Upcoming stock splits with ratio and execution date.

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Stop after this many calendar rows.

dedupe.title: Deduplicate
dedupe.description: Drop duplicate event rows (same type, symbol and date).
